newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton prices extend losses, low mill demand.
newsitem.headline: India cotton prices extend losses, low mill demand.

text.p: Indian cotton prices extended losses on Tuesday on low mill demand and higher new crop arrival, dealers said.
New crop arrivals in the Punjab region rose to 28-30,000 bales (170 kg each).

In spot deals Bengal-desi slid by 10 rupees to 880/910 per maund (37.32 Kg) while Punjab sawginned fell by 10 to 1540/1640. Gujarat Sankar 4 (long staple) fell by 200 to 18,000/19,000 per candy (355.56Kg).
